question: Does reducing only Demis's public Mandate at Capability 9 and 12 move the faction toward parity while preserving all technical progress and Research behavior?

demis.protectedStrength: Starting Compute, every Research action, Scientific Method reliability, Nobel Trust, Scaling-Law Capability, and permanent Capability remain canonical.
demis.bottleneck: Capability 9 and 12 remain technical achievements but each grants Demis one public Mandate instead of two.
demis.eligibility: Reject the candidate if it reduces Capability, Research selection, Scientific Method use, or late-threshold attainment rather than only changing public validation.

requiredDiagnostics: configuration-specific Demis win share, mean Mandate, and mean rank by player count
Capability 9 and 12 attainment and Mandate by threshold
Research selections, Scientific Method uses, Capability preserved, and Scaling-Law Capability
paired faction win-share, score, and rank delta
forced no-ops, policy fallbacks, and integrity violations

selectionRule.demis: Select only if four-player Demis moves materially toward parity, three and five remain competitive, and all technical realization is unchanged.
selectionRule.pairedAuthority: Compare the candidate only with canonical under common seeds. Positive paired rankDelta means improved placement.
selectionRule.integrity: Any integrity violation, policy fallback, unsupported-count gap, missing faction standing, or missing late-validation realization rejects the probe.
selectionRule.promotion: No physical text changes without a tracked receipt, complete surface audit, a new immutable candidate, and explicit user approval.
